about_the_game:
Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic – A Gamebook Revolution!

No more paper, pencils, or messy notes—this game transforms reading into a dynamic, interactive adventure where the book itself becomes the beating heart of the gameplay.

Uncover a story of friendship that transcends worlds, one page at a time. Explore treacherous dungeons, battle fierce enemies, and manage hundreds of items in your inventory. Immerse yourself in this epic journey, strategize your moves, shape your own destiny, and become the protagonist of the gamebook’s evolution.

Read the BOOK. Play the GAME. Live the ADVENTURE.

Customize Your Party & Prepare for Battle!

Step into the shoes of Mar, the hero of this grand tale, and journey through the magical lands of Ellyrïa. Embark on thrilling quests, delve into perilous dungeons, and uncover hidden secrets. Recruit a diverse cast of companions, each specializing in unique classes, combat techniques, and powerful magic.

Before heading into battle, carefully choose the best equipment, optimize your skills to create the most effective combat synergies, and craft healing potions, explosive vials, and other essential items to survive. With countless strategic possibilities, adapt your playstyle and overcome any challenge that stands in your way!

 

A Turn-Based Combat System Inspired by Genre Classics

Every member of your party can unleash swift attacks, cast powerful spells, or use items to gain the upper hand in battle. But be careful—each action consumes valuable action points! Plan your moves wisely to defeat enemies efficiently, level up, and unlock even more powerful abilities.




The Final Version of Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic Will be packed with Content!

✔️ 9 chapters filled with twists and surprises
✔️ 20+ hours of thrilling gameplay
✔️ 18 dungeons teeming with monsters and traps
✔️ 40+ enemy types and bosses for intense battles
✔️ 25 unique techniques and spells per character
✔️ 100+ items, weapons, and accessories to collect or purchase
✔️ 6 diverse biomes to explore

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure where the gamebook meets the RPG experience like never before!
